rationale: Executive Order 13348 (69 FR 44885) is held as an official Federal Register text and concerns Liberia: it declared a national emergency and blocked property. The official Federal Register text of Executive Order 13710 (80 FR 71679) says "Accordingly, I hereby terminate the national emergency declared in Executive Order 13348, revoke that order, and further order:" and section 3(a) makes the order effective at 2:00 p.m. eastern standard time on November 12, 2015. The order is wholly revoked, with no part excepted, and the only savings are accrued matters under section 202(a) of the NEA, so it was not in force on 2026-10-14. The single history observation is OFR editorial data of continuation notices and the revocation entry; the Treasury continuation notice of July 17, 2015 shows the measures continuing until then, so there is no earlier ending.
